summary.headline: Mars and Its Significations
summary.text: Astrological account of Mars: his effects on violence, warfare, crime, weather, sea, agriculture, bodily parts, diseases, accidents, and crafts, with comparisons of Ptolemy’s and Valens’s attributions. The opening also describes Jupiter opposed to an increasing or decreasing Moon and its effects on rulership and fortune.
